Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub:  Audio Recording of Earning Conference Call held on 21st July, 2026 
 
In terms of Regulation 30(6) and Regulation 46 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform that the audio recording 
of the Conference Call with analysts and investors held on 21st July, 2026, to discuss the 
Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th 
June, 2026, is available on the website of the Company and can be accessed at below link: 
 
Audio_Recording_Q1_FY_2026_27.mp3

Thanking you,
